name: io.github.Abhishek-B-R/social0-mcp
title: Social0
description: Post and schedule to X, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and more from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List all social media accounts connected to the user's Social0 account. Use when the user asks to see connected accounts, which platforms are linked, or before creating a post to know available targets. Example: 'Show my connected accounts.'

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.description: Create an unpublished Social0 draft (does not post to any network). Use when the user wants to write content first and publish/schedule later. Example: 'Draft a LinkedIn post about AI.'

platforms.description: Platform names (linkedin, twitter_x, etc.) or connected account UUIDs

platform_options.description: Advanced per-platform settings. Supports content/caption and media per platform, plus pinterest board_id/title/link/create_board, tiktok title/privacy/draft/comment/duet/stitch/commercial/AI flags, instagram cover_image_url/trial_reel, youtube title, and x/twitter_x madeWithAi/paidPartnership.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Same key = same post: reuse it when retrying this exact call. Without it, an identical call within 10 minutes is treated as a retry.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: update_draft
tools.description: Update an unpublished Social0 draft or scheduled post — caption, platforms, or media. Does not edit already-published live posts.

post_id.description: Draft or scheduled post ID to update

platforms.description: Updated target platforms or account IDs

platform_options.description: Advanced per-platform settings. Supports content/caption and media per platform, plus pinterest board_id/title/link/create_board, tiktok title/privacy/draft/comment/duet/stitch/commercial/AI flags, instagram cover_image_url/trial_reel, youtube title, and x/twitter_x madeWithAi/paidPartnership.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: delete_draft
tools.description: Delete an unpublished Social0 draft or scheduled post from Social0. Published/live social posts cannot be deleted with this tool — only drafts and not-yet-published schedules. Example: 'Delete yesterday's draft.'

post_id.description: Draft or scheduled post ID to delete (not a published post)

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List the user's Social0 posts with optional filters by status, platform, account, or search text. Use when the user asks to see drafts, scheduled posts, or published content. Example: 'Show all scheduled posts.'

account.description: Filter by connected account UUID or unambiguous platform name

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Get full details of a single Social0 post by ID, including caption, status, platforms, media, and schedule time.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: publish_post
tools.description: Publish an existing unpublished Social0 draft (or scheduled post) immediately to connected platforms. Returns a tracking ID to monitor progress. Example: 'Publish my latest draft to Twitter.'

post_id.description: Draft or scheduled post ID to publish immediately

platforms.description: Optional subset of platforms/account IDs to publish to

media.description: Optional media IDs from upload_media to attach before publishing

platform_options.description: Advanced per-platform settings. Supports content/caption and media per platform, plus pinterest board_id/title/link/create_board, tiktok title/privacy/draft/comment/duet/stitch/commercial/AI flags, instagram cover_image_url/trial_reel, youtube title, and x/twitter_x madeWithAi/paidPartnership.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Same key = same post: reuse it when retrying this exact call. Without it, an identical call within 10 minutes is treated as a retry.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: schedule_post
tools.description: Schedule an existing unpublished Social0 draft for future publishing at a specific date and time. Example: 'Schedule tomorrow's announcement at 9 AM.'

media.description: Optional media IDs from upload_media to attach before scheduling

platform_options.description: Advanced per-platform settings. Supports content/caption and media per platform, plus pinterest board_id/title/link/create_board, tiktok title/privacy/draft/comment/duet/stitch/commercial/AI flags, instagram cover_image_url/trial_reel, youtube title, and x/twitter_x madeWithAi/paidPartnership.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: upload_media
tools.description: Upload an image or video to Social0 and get a media ID for posts. For remote AI hosts (Claude.ai, ChatGPT), pass url (public direct file URL) or data (base64). file_path only works when the MCP server can read that path on its own machine.

file_path.description: Local path on the MCP server machine. Do not use for remote sandboxes.

url.description: Public http(s) URL to download. Must be a direct file link the server can fetch.

data.description: Base64 file bytes or a data: URL (data:image/png;base64,...).

filename.description: Filename with extension (required for bare base64 data; optional for url).

mime_type.description: MIME type if not clear from filename/url (e.g. image/png).

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: publish_now
tools.description: Create content and publish it live to connected platforms in one step (writes to external social networks).

platform_options.description: Advanced per-platform settings. Supports content/caption and media per platform, plus pinterest board_id/title/link/create_board, tiktok title/privacy/draft/comment/duet/stitch/commercial/AI flags, instagram cover_image_url/trial_reel, youtube title, and x/twitter_x madeWithAi/paidPartnership.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Same key = same post: reuse it when retrying this exact call. Without it, an identical call within 10 minutes is treated as a retry.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: schedule_content
tools.description: Create content and schedule it for future publishing in one step (does not publish immediately). Example: 'Schedule a LinkedIn post about our launch for tomorrow at 9 AM.'

platform_options.description: Advanced per-platform settings. Supports content/caption and media per platform, plus pinterest board_id/title/link/create_board, tiktok title/privacy/draft/comment/duet/stitch/commercial/AI flags, instagram cover_image_url/trial_reel, youtube title, and x/twitter_x madeWithAi/paidPartnership.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Same key = same post: reuse it when retrying this exact call. Without it, an identical call within 10 minutes is treated as a retry.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: get_publish_status
tools.description: Check the publishing status of a post using its tracking ID. Returns overall status, per-platform progress, and any errors.

tracking_id.description: Tracking ID returned from publish operations

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: suggest_best_platforms
tools.description: Analyze post content and recommend which social platforms are the best fit. Considers text length, media presence, and connected accounts. Example: 'Which platforms should I publish this to?'

media_type.description: Explicit content type. Prefer image/video/collection over only toggling has_media.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: get_analytics
tools.description: Live performance metrics for posts published through Social0 in a date window: totals, per-platform breakdown, daily series, and top posts. Metrics are read from each network at call time. Use when the user asks how their posts are doing, which platform performs best, or for engagement/views numbers. Example: 'How did my posts do last month?'

range.description: Lookback window. Use custom with since/until.

account.description: Connected account UUID or unambiguous platform name

fresh.description: Bypass warm cache and re-read the platform APIs. Entries younger than 90s are still served from cache.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: get_post_analytics
tools.description: Live metrics for one Social0 post, broken out per network it was published to. Use after list_posts or get_post when the user asks how a specific post performed.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: list_inbox_comments
tools.description: Read comment threads on posts published through Social0, fetched live from each network. Each thread carries the `comment_id` and `publication_id` needed to reply, like, or hide. Use when the user asks what people are saying, or wants to triage replies. Example: 'Any comments I haven't answered?'

range.description: Lookback window. Use custom with since/until.

account.description: Connected account UUID or unambiguous platform name

fresh.description: Bypass warm cache and re-read the platform APIs. Entries younger than 90s are still served from cache.

platform.description: Limit to one platform (e.g. bluesky, twitter_x, youtube)

before.description: Cursor from a previous response's next_before

unanswered_only.description: Only threads the connected account has not replied to

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: reply_to_comment
tools.description: Post a public reply to a comment on the originating network. Requires both `comment_id` and the `publication_id` from list_inbox_comments — Social0 verifies the comment is on that post before sending. This is a live public action.

media_id.description: Media upload ID. Only X and Bluesky accept comment attachments.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: moderate_comment
tools.description: Like, unlike, or hide a comment. Hiding is Instagram and Facebook Pages only. Requires `publication_id` from list_inbox_comments. Hiding is a moderation action.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: list_inbox_dms
tools.description: List direct-message conversations for connected accounts that support DMs (X and Bluesky today). Returns conversation_id + account_id needed to open or reply to a thread.

range.description: Lookback window. Use custom with since/until.

account.description: Connected account UUID or unambiguous platform name

fresh.description: Bypass warm cache and re-read the platform APIs. Entries younger than 90s are still served from cache.

before.description: Cursor from a previous response's next_before

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: get_inbox_dm_thread
tools.description: Read the most recent messages in one DM conversation. conversation_id comes from list_inbox_dms. Pass the returned cursor to read older messages.

account.description: Connected account UUID or platform name that owns the conversation

peer_id.description: Only needed when the platform omits it

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous call, to read older messages

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: reply_to_dm
tools.description: Send a message into an existing DM conversation. Social0 verifies the conversation belongs to the account before sending. This delivers a real message to a real person.

account.description: Connected account UUID or platform name that owns the conversation

media_id.description: Media upload ID. X accepts image and video, TikTok image only, Bluesky text only.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Show the Social0 user this connection acts as: name, email, plan and timezone. Use when the user asks who they are signed in as or which plan they are on.

tools.name: list_workspaces
tools.description: List the team/client workspaces the user belongs to, with their role and permissions in each. Passing a workspace's id as workspace_id scopes the other tools to that team, client or brand. Without workspace_id every tool acts on the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: connect_account
tools.description: Start connecting a social account. Returns an authorization_url: give the link to the user to open and approve in their browser (you cannot complete it), then call list_accounts. X (twitter_x) and Bluesky must be connected from the Social0 dashboard; the server says so.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: disconnect_account
tools.description: Disconnect a connected social account from Social0. Its scheduled posts to that account will not go out.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: delete_posts
tools.description: Delete up to 100 draft or scheduled posts in one call. Published posts are not deletable and come back in failed. Returns { deleted, failed: [{ id, error }] }.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: duplicate_post
tools.description: Copy any post into a new unpublished draft (same text, media and targets). Returns the new draft id.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Same key = same post: reuse it when retrying this exact call. Without it, an identical call within 10 minutes is treated as a retry.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: post_again
tools.description: Republish a published or partial post as a NEW post, live now, to the same accounts. Returns post_id and tracking_id for get_publish_status. Retrying only the failed accounts on an existing post is publish_post.

post_id.description: Published or partial post to repost

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Same key = same post: reuse it when retrying this exact call. Without it, an identical call within 10 minutes is treated as a retry.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: set_auto_plug
tools.description: X only (Creator/Agency plans): when a published post reaches a likes or retweets threshold, Social0 replies to it with message. Editable for 24 hours after publishing. Creates or replaces the post's auto-plug.

message.description: Reply text posted when the threshold is hit

account_id.description: X account, when the post went to more than one

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: cancel_auto_plug
tools.description: Cancel the pending auto-plug reply on an X post so it is never sent.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: set_auto_repost
tools.description: Turn on or change automatic reposting of a published post: repost every interval_hours, up to max_reposts times, optionally with a message. Returns { post_id, schedule_id }.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: cancel_auto_repost
tools.description: Stop automatic reposting of a post. Reposts already published stay up.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: get_post_events
tools.description: Publish timeline for a post: each phase per platform with its message. Use to explain why a post failed or what happened while publishing.

workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List the user's webhook endpoints (post.published, post.failed, post.scheduled, post.deleted) with their last delivery result.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Register a public https URL to receive post events. Returns the signing secret once; give it to the user.

tools.name: get_webhook
tools.description: Get one webhook endpoint: URL, events, active flag and its last delivery result.

tools.name: update_webhook
tools.description: Change a webhook's URL or events, or pause/resume it with active.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook endpoint. It stops receiving events.

tools.name: list_webhook_deliveries
tools.description: Delivery attempts for one webhook, newest first, with response status and error. Use to answer "did Social0 send it?". Page with before = next_before.

tools.name: test_webhook
tools.description: Send a signed webhook.test ping to the endpoint now and report what it answered.
